campaign: Northeast Ohio Treasure Hunt — Tom Colosimo & Participating Business Demo
presentation_goal: Show Tom and participating businesses how Places Rewards turns Treasure Hunt traffic into measurable visits, repeat business, referrals and sponsor-ready ROI.

modules.label: Hunter Passport
modules.title: Hunter Passport — Join Once, Keep Earning
modules.subtitle: Capture the participant before the first visit becomes anonymous traffic.
modules.description: Every hunter receives a digital passport tied to the Treasure Hunt. It becomes the identity layer for points, visits, rewards, referrals and post-hunt follow-up across participating businesses.
bullets: One enrollment connects the hunter to the full campaign
Stores reward progress across participating businesses
Creates a permissioned relationship that can continue after the hunt
modules.why_tom: The hunt can generate attention; the Hunter Passport turns that attention into an audience Tom and the merchants can continue serving.

modules.label: Explorer Trail
modules.title: 5-Stop Explorer Trail — Move Traffic Across Town
modules.subtitle: Give hunters a reason to visit multiple participating businesses instead of stopping at one clue location.
modules.description: A five-stop digital stamp trail sends hunters from business to business. Each verified stop adds progress toward a completion reward and makes cross-merchant traffic measurable.
bullets: Five clearly numbered merchant stops
Visible progress keeps hunters moving
Completion reward encourages the full route instead of a single visit
modules.why_tom: This makes participation more valuable to merchants because the campaign intentionally circulates traffic through the network.

modules.label: Business Discovery
modules.title: Participating Business Discovery — Make Every Merchant Visible
modules.subtitle: Turn sponsor participation into a discoverable reason to visit.
modules.description: Each participating business gets a dedicated discovery presence that can show its logo, location, category, Treasure Hunt offer and visit reason without revealing or changing official clues.
bullets: Merchant logo and business-specific information
Category and location discovery
A distinct offer or reason to visit for each participating business
modules.why_tom: The organizer can deliver visible sponsor value before, during and after clue activity instead of relying only on passive logo placement.

modules.label: Clue Reward
modules.title: Clue Completion Reward — Reward the Visit, Not the Answer
modules.subtitle: Add measurable commercial value around the official clue while keeping the treasure hunt itself untouched.
modules.description: After a verified clue-related visit or approved activity, the hunter can unlock a merchant-funded reward such as bonus points, a local perk or a limited offer. The official clue and treasure odds remain completely separate.
bullets: Official clues remain independent
Merchants can attach a relevant reward to verified activity
Every reward can be attributed to the campaign
modules.why_tom: Tom keeps full control of the hunt while Places Rewards adds a measurable engagement layer around it.

modules.label: Merchant Check-In
modules.title: Merchant Check-In — Prove the Foot Traffic
modules.subtitle: Replace guesswork with a verified visit at the participating business.
modules.description: The merchant scans or verifies the hunter at the point of visit. That action can issue a stamp, points or eligibility for the next reward while creating a trackable campaign visit.
bullets: Fast QR or staff-assisted verification
Can trigger stamps, points or reward eligibility
Creates merchant-level visit data for the organizer
modules.why_tom: This is the proof layer that shows participating businesses the Treasure Hunt actually sent people through their doors.

modules.label: Local Prize
modules.title: Local Prize & Giveaway — Give Every Business a Win Moment
modules.subtitle: Create sponsor inventory and excitement beyond the single grand treasure.
modules.description: Participating businesses can contribute a prize, experience or reward tied to verified campaign activity. Hunters gain more chances to win while sponsors gain a concrete promotional role in the hunt.
bullets: Merchant-funded prizes and experiences
Eligibility can be tied to visits or milestones
Adds sponsor value without changing the main treasure
modules.why_tom: More businesses can participate meaningfully because each sponsor can have its own promotional moment and measurable engagement.

modules.label: Referral
modules.title: Bring Another Hunter — Let Participants Grow the Hunt
modules.subtitle: Turn word-of-mouth into trackable participant acquisition.
modules.description: Every hunter gets a referral path they can share with friends and family. When a new hunter joins through it, the system can attribute the referral and reward both people after a qualifying action.
bullets: Unique referral attribution
Optional reward for inviter and new hunter
Reduces dependence on paid promotion for participant growth
modules.why_tom: The community becomes a measurable acquisition channel for the next hunt instead of relying only on social reach.

modules.label: Hunter VIP
modules.title: Hunter VIP — Reward the People Who Support Local Most
modules.subtitle: Turn the most active hunters into a recognized community segment.
modules.description: Hunters who accumulate visits, points or qualifying activity can move into a VIP tier with stronger perks, early access, special experiences or premium merchant offers.
bullets: Visible progression beyond one event
Recognizes repeat local support
Creates a premium segment for future hunts and merchant promotions
modules.why_tom: The Treasure Hunt evolves from a one-time event into a community membership engine with a highly engaged core audience.

modules.label: Mystery Bonus
modules.title: Mystery Bonus Scratch & Win — Add Instant Excitement
modules.subtitle: Give merchants an instant-win engagement tool that never affects the real treasure.
modules.description: After a qualifying visit, a hunter can receive a digital scratch card for a merchant perk, bonus points, surprise discount or defined local prize. The win rate and prize inventory are controlled separately from the official hunt.
bullets: Instant gratification after a visit
Configurable prize inventory and win rate
Creates repeatable excitement between official clues
modules.why_tom: It adds sponsor inventory and entertainment without compromising the integrity of the Treasure Hunt.

modules.label: Comeback Offer
modules.title: Hunter Comeback Offer — Turn the First Visit Into the Second
modules.subtitle: Convert Treasure Hunt traffic into post-hunt merchant revenue.
modules.description: A time-limited comeback voucher gives the hunter a concrete reason to return to a participating business after the hunt visit. The demo uses $5 off $25, but each merchant can define its own economics.
bullets: Designed specifically to trigger a second visit
Minimum spend protects merchant economics
Redemption creates attributable post-hunt revenue activity
modules.why_tom: This is where the campaign stops being only an event and starts becoming a customer-retention system for participating businesses.

modules.label: Post-Hunt Retention
modules.title: Post-Hunt Retention — Keep the Customer Relationship Alive
modules.subtitle: Continue working after the final clue, winner announcement and prize ceremony.
modules.description: Places Rewards can segment hunters by activity and prepare timed follow-up such as thank-you messages, unfinished-trail reminders, merchant offers, VIP invitations and early interest for the next hunt.
bullets: Different follow-up for active, inactive and near-complete hunters
Merchant offers can be triggered at the relevant time
Builds the audience for the next hunt automatically
modules.why_tom: The event team does not have to manually chase thousands of participants after the hunt ends.

modules.label: Analytics & ROI
modules.title: Organizer & Merchant ROI — Prove What the Hunt Produced
modules.subtitle: Finish the workflow with evidence Tom can use to renew sponsors and grow the next hunt.
modules.description: The organizer dashboard connects enrollments, visits, stamps, rewards, referrals, voucher redemptions and return activity into a measurable campaign story for Tom and participating businesses.
bullets: Track participation across the complete journey
Show merchant-level activity and campaign outcomes
Use results to improve the next hunt and strengthen sponsor renewal conversations
modules.why_tom: This is the subscription closer: Places Rewards gives Tom proof of value that continues after the treasure is found.
